//: Deno config for type-checking the edge functions in CI (E3). Deliberately lives at supabase/ rather than supabase/functions/ — it is an ancestor of the functions, so `deno check` picks it up, but it is not inside the directory the Supabase CLI deploys, so it cannot change what runs in production. The edge runtime resolves npm: specifiers itself; this only teaches a local/CI Deno to do the same.
